implementation.entry: Orders > Manage delivered order > Review driver rating; public order number accepted; open cases in operational case queue
implementation.source: Original ORDER# rating, own delivered order/driver/customer binding, immutable original stars and comment
implementation.review: Opening or appeal excludes driver rating temporarily; KEEP restores original stars; EXCLUDE preserves original opinion but removes its aggregate contribution; PENDING remains excluded
implementation.evidence: Received claims explicitly do not establish fault. Restoring reviewed rating requires two distinct source parties. Reason, owner, decision supersession and immutable event journal. Driver or customer appeal may be recorded by authorized staff.
implementation.concurrency: Order, staff, driver lifecycle, rating source, review version, driver profile and rating aggregate exact guards in one transaction; same UUID receipt handles uncertain retry. Customer aggregate additions retain moderation counters.
implementation.counterConservation: Included + underReview + excluded preserves total received driver ratings; zero included produces null mean, not zero stars.
implementation.money: No wallets, ledger or order edits. Merchant rating aggregate never modified by this service. No agent business-case decisions.
implementation.policy: No new automatic eligibility, safety fault or wave ranking policy
